name: skoolbox-reviewer-portal
description: Online curriculum review portal for the SkoolBox dataset (Cloudflare Pages + D1).

scripts.db:init: npm run check && npx wrangler d1 execute skoolbox-reviews --file=schema.sql --remote
scripts.check:
node -e "const t=require('fs').readFileSync('wrangler.toml','utf8'); if(t.includes('PASTE_DATABASE_ID_HERE')){console.error('
[X] wrangler.toml still has the placeholder database_id.
    Run: npx wrangler d1 create skoolbox-reviews
    then paste the printed database_id into wrangler.toml.
');process.exit(1)} console.log('[ok] wrangler.toml has a database_id')"
